channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Alabama gets $3.8 million grant to boost early childhood education
item.description: The competitive federal funding will strengthen and align the state's early childhood education system, focusing on rural regions and underserved communities.

item.title: Opinion | Collaboration that empowers job creators
item.description: The Department of Workforce is proving daily that it is an example of what successful collaboration looks like.

item.title: Speedy Trial Act used in capital murder case of Lowndes sheriff
item.description: Chief Justice Stewart appointed a retired judge to preside over the capital murder case, utilizing the new Speedy Trial Act for the first time.

item.title: House Education Policy Committee passes bill to limit screen time in early childhood education
item.description: The Healthy Early Development and Screen Time Act passed unanimously, limiting screen time for children 5 and younger in publicly funded learning centers.

item.title: Senate Judiciary Committee passes bills on voting rights restoration, increased criminal penalties
item.description: The Alabama Senate Judiciary Committee approved measures streamlining voting rights restoration for felons and increasing penalties for reckless endangerment and illegal handicap parking.

item.title: GOP SNAP bill could cost Alabama millions, require 800 new staff, commissioner says
item.description: The Department of Human Resources commissioner told senators they were “going to be astounded at the cost” of SB61.

item.title: Alabama House committee OKs bill to limit Mobile Bay dredge dumping
item.description: The bill mandates that entities dredging millions of cubic yards must beneficially use 70 percent of the material, promoting marsh creation.

item.title: Bill creates veteran teaching pathway amid statewide teacher shortage
item.description: The Senate Education Policy Committee advanced a bill that would create a new temporary teacher certificate for military veterans

item.title: House committee advances bill targetting false identification, refusal to comply
item.description: The new legislation advanced by the committee expanded the state's false-name statute and created a misdemeanor for knowingly withholding identifying information.

item.title: Lawmakers claim citizen concerns over ICE bill are fear-mongering
item.description: During a contentious public hearing, state lawmakers dismissed testimony from citizens, asserting their concerns about the new immigration bill were financially motivated fear.
